tasks.title: Implement user rights, scoped exports and guest requests
tasks.scope: Implement accessible EN/FA access/export, correction, erasure, restriction, objection, portability and withdrawal requests with proportionate requester verification, a no-account guest route, operator queue, jurisdiction deadlines and status receipts. tasks.progress_note: Own-account Work/Personal export, EN/FA note correction, RI1 request intake and RI2 retention operations are implemented. RI2 binds original audit/closure floors, explicitly reassesses unresolved cases, purges only eligible terminal records and retains finite scoped continuity/410 receipts. Independent RI2 local acceptance passed 36 cases. Formal restriction/objection, guest verification, provider/backups and broader rights fulfillment remain open. Prior additional independent immediate-export race proof remains unavailable after automatic security review; no replacement execution is claimed. GI1 guest metadata intake, bounded separate ledger, current-operator queue, key continuity, final authority fences and finite retention/status receipts are implemented behind reviewed-policy/key configuration. Independent review caught and verified the fix for a short purge-receipt horizon. Actual compiled proxy testing also exposed internal/public-origin mismatch; all six affected handlers now use the trusted server URL. Composed independent acceptance passed 158 external cases and 117 repository regressions; compiled/CI/release evidence remains bound to its exact candidate. Guest recovery-code possession never proves identity or authorizes private-data disclosure. RF1 scoped local-use slice on candidate 6c0718ec84a6e141e3cf22d0758782aa17611146 (tree 8dd033ed35801c0807f61765b844b507a1bc7cf9; base e5cf00f2f8b460bef956bc28f2535b4e1c7a8b0e) passed independent source acceptance (39/39, 11 files; 981 source hashes unchanged), production build, and CI230 tests/E2E (4,001 passed, 13 existing skips across 287 files). CI also passed 46 Node checks and 41 existing browser journeys; those browser journeys do not cover RF1 controls. Audit is not clean (exit 1; 14 findings, 8 moderate/6 high; continue-on-error). Compiled-app SQLite and FILE attempt09 each passed 13/13 (26 total); independent combined browser acceptance passed 26/26 (13 SQLite + 13 FILE), zero failures/skips/flaky; report and 110-file manifest are recorded in RIGHTS_LOCAL_USE.md. The runs use mock transport and synthetic identities; OS isolation, native browser zoom/language selection, physical-device and provider behavior remain unavailable. Candidate 25a2661 was rejected and historical evidence is preserved. RF1 covers requester account plus selected space/purpose only; it does not complete VOX-056 or establish legal compliance. RF1 PR #84 is merged and deployed as `cf63acf64c6eadf5a2247d2436e0a22bc114386b` (tree `a6a67d26f0e73addafb0dae4ff6b4e6301c82f0a`, build `FHheoV7JKPeQMsUBuCMEZ`); production legacy FILE and optional-policy configuration remain unchanged/off. 40 local/public unauthenticated route contracts and five bot ownership/configuration checks passed. No provider generation, authenticated live-user journey or device voice qualification occurred. RF1 does not complete VOX-056. Metadata retirement, RF2 erasure, provider/backup deletion, production IAM, legal eligibility and provider/device/user-flow gates remain open. فارسی: PR #84 ادغام و RF1 با ساخت `FHheoV7JKPeQMsUBuCMEZ` روی `cf63acf64c6eadf5a2247d2436e0a22bc114386b` مستقر شد؛ FILE قدیمی و سیاست‌های اختیاری بدون تغییر/خاموش ماندند. ۴۰ قرارداد مسیر محلی/عمومی بدون احراز هویت و پنج بررسی مالکیت/پیکربندی ربات موفق شدند. تولید ارائه‌دهنده، مسیر کاربر واردشده یا صلاحیت صدای دستگاه انجام نشد. RF1 کل VOX-056 را کامل نمی‌کند؛ بازنشستگی فراداده، RF2، حذف ارائه‌دهنده/پشتیبان، IAM، حقوقی و پذیرش کاربر/ارائه‌دهنده/دستگاه باز هستند.
